THE RULING - seed production to match the repo, NOT shrink the repo to match production. Decision rule: when repo and production disagree about a seeded catalogue, the side that wins is the side the ALREADY-APPLIED halves of the same change depend on; shrinking is correct only when the rows were authored ahead of a feature whose other halves are also unshipped. They are not: hr_companion_grants (the 17-row allowlist) and hr_companion_grant(int,text,text,uuid) are BOTH live on production, the RPC is granted to authenticated and called from src/net/goal-claim.js grantCompanion via src/features/companions.js maybeServerGrant, and src/net/accrue.js reconcileCompanions REPLACES G.companions from the server owned-set under the capstone arm (src/net/capstone.js BLOB_RETIRED = true; isServerAccrualEnabled() defaults TRUE). The missing rows are load-bearing, not dormant: PROVEN on production 2026-08-30 in a self-aborting DO block against a synthetic uuid (nothing written) that player_progress_unlock_guard answers `23514 / unknown_unlock: companion:badger` while the control companion:sparrow reaches `23503 / FK`, i.e. the guard PASSES for a catalogued id. hr_companion_grant has no exception handler, so every legitimate non-shop acquisition raises instead of returning a machine code and the companion is dropped on the next reload - the exact player loss b453 was written to prevent. Not yet hit only because nobody has acquired one since 2026-08-23 (0 companion:% unlock rows, 0 companion_grant ledger rows, `fox` the only equipped companion across 35 characters). WHAT IT DOES: one INSERT of 17 rows DERIVED from public.hr_companion_grants (never restated as a literal, so the storage catalogue and the security allowlist cannot disagree), pinned BY VALUE against the seventeen reviewed ids, upsert-scoped so a re-run re-syncs shape and nothing else. It touches no function, grant, policy, offer or player row, and it does NOT re-apply a wholesale catalogue owner. SECURITY / ECONOMY DELTA - ACK REQUESTED: it is NOT a shop-shelf change (none of the 17 has an hr_unlock_offers row; no gold or gem price is added; the migration ASSERTS grantable-intersect-priced = empty), but it does ARM an already-live client-callable RPC that is currently inert by accident. hr_companion_grant has no server-verifiable precondition for 16 of the 17 (only whelp has req_item dragon_egg, best-effort by that file's own design), so an authenticated caller can obtain any of them without meeting the drop/skill/quest/boss condition. MEASURED magnitude by evaluating src/core/companion-perk.js - the only companion channel the accrual prices - base -> level-30: lichling allXP 0.01 -> 0.0245 (identical to the FREE starter fox, so net zero), beaver/heron/rock_golem gatherSpeed, forge_imp smithSpeed, phoenix_chick cookSpeed, grave_wisp prayerSpeed, silkling craftSpeed all 0.01 -> 0.0245, bunny/squirrel farmYield 1 -> 2.45, and badger/dragonling/hawk/scorpion/tortoise/whelp/wolf_pup SERVER-PRICED NOTHING (their strB/atkB/defB/crit/rareDrop keys are not in the server perk channel, so dragonling's rareDrop 0.15 never reaches a drop roll). Exactly ONE companion equips at a time, so the ceiling per character is one of those. The concrete bypass is a free beaver/heron/rock_golem instead of sparrow (5,000 g), phoenix_chick instead of honeybee (8,000 g) or grave_wisp instead of owl (8,000 g); raccoon (25,000 g, goldFind) has no free equivalent. NOTE FOR THE REVIEWER: b453's own header claims these grants are self-only-cosmetic because companion perks are 'not server-projected'. That is TRUE for the combat-stat pets and FALSE for the nine speed/xp/yield pets above - 2026-08-20-companion-model.sql wired the companion channel into hr_perks_of two days BEFORE b453 was written, so the premise b453 was signed off on was already stale. Re-rule on the measured list, not on that sentence. If the surface is judged unacceptable the remedy is a server-verifiable precondition inside hr_companion_grant (gate source_kind='skill' on hr_level_from_xp over player_skills, the read 2026-08-19-companion-unlocks.sql's skill gate already uses), NOT withholding the storage rows - that only converts a design question into a 23514 and a player-visible data loss. APPLY AFTER 2026-08-11-player-state.sql, 2026-08-16-unlocks.generated.sql, 2026-08-16-artisan-progress-model.sql and 2026-08-22-companion-grant.sql, and after ANY re-apply of the wholesale owner.
